parrafo.es: Remocion de arboles, poda, desraizado y limpieza de terrenos en Ocala y Marion County. Kirk Parker y su equipo llegan con el equipo correcto, incluso para arboles de 80 pies, y dejan la propiedad impecable.
parrafo.en: Tree removal, trimming, stump grinding and land clearing across Ocala and Marion County. Kirk Parker and his crew show up with the right equipment, even for 80-foot trees, and leave the property spotless.

hero.imagen_alt: Crew using a crane to carefully remove tall oak trees next to a home in Ocala

parrafo_1.es: Parker's Tree Service, liderado por Kirk Parker, atiende Ocala y Marion County: remocion de arboles grandes, poda, desraizado y limpieza de terrenos, incluso en fincas y propiedades rurales.
parrafo_1.en: Parker's Tree Service, led by Kirk Parker, serves Ocala and Marion County: large tree removal, trimming, stump grinding and land clearing, including farms and rural properties.

parrafo_2.es: Los clientes destacan la rapidez de respuesta (muchas veces al dia siguiente), el equipo bien organizado y que la propiedad queda impecable al terminar, incluso despues de arboles de 80 pies.
parrafo_2.en: Customers point to how fast the crew responds, often the next day, how organized and well-equipped the team is, and that the property is left spotless when the job is done, even after 80-foot trees.

texto.es: Cuentas que arboles necesitas revisar. La respuesta es rapida, muchas veces para el dia siguiente.
texto.en: Tell us what trees need attention. The response is fast, often for the next day.

texto.es: Kirk evalua el arbol o terreno y te explica el plan antes de empezar, sin sorpresas.
texto.en: Kirk evaluates the tree or lot and walks you through the plan before starting, no surprises.

texto.es: Remocion, poda o desraizado con el equipo adecuado, incluso para arboles de 80 pies.
texto.en: Removal, trimming or stump grinding with the right equipment, even for 80-foot trees.

texto.es: El equipo se lleva toda la madera y los desechos, y deja el terreno limpio al terminar.
texto.en: The crew hauls away all the wood and debris and leaves the lot clean when they're done.

nota.es: Cada trabajo se cotiza segun el arbol y el terreno. Llama y Kirk te da el precio antes de empezar.
nota.en: Every job is quoted based on the tree and the lot. Call and Kirk will give you the price before starting.

texto.es: Desde arboles de 80 pies hasta ramas caidas por tormenta, retirados con grua y camiones de grapa.
texto.en: From 80-foot trees to storm-dropped limbs, taken down with a crane and grapple trucks.

texto.es: Poda de palmas y arboles altos para proteger techos, cercas y lineas electricas.
texto.en: Trimming of palms and tall trees to protect roofs, fences and power lines.

texto.es: Eliminacion del tocon despues de la tala, para dejar el terreno listo para usar.
texto.en: Stump removal after the tree comes down, so the lot is ready to use.

texto.es: Despeje de maleza y arboles para proyectos de construccion o fincas.
texto.en: Brush and tree clearing for building projects or farm properties.

pie.es: ¿Tu proyecto no encaja en estas categorias? Llama igual, seguro Kirk puede ayudarte.
pie.en: Does your project not fit these categories? Call anyway, Kirk can likely still help.

items.quote: Kirk and the crew worked extra hard to drop one of our 80ft trees in our backyard. Another 2 to go!! 2 full grapple trucks to take it all away!! Hard working and honest, thanks so much.

Awesome service! Fastest response to inquiry. Came next day! Knocked out the huge job in 2 days. Ensured I was happy with the job and gave me a more than fair price! Will recommend to anyone needing tree service!

I cannot recommend Parker's Tree Service enough. The crew was courteous, hardworking, and took great care to leave the property pristine after the job was finished. Their knowledge and skill were evident in every aspect of their work.

texto.en: Open 6am to 10pm, 7 days a week. Tell us about your project and we'll give you the price.
